epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在東京廣闊的城市版圖中探索一種飲食文化,它不僅維持了工薪族的風格,還保留了其烹飪傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the vast urban sprawl of Tokyo, Adam Liaw explores a food culture that not only sustains the `salaryman workers in style but retains culinary traditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明查訪了一些東京的瘋狂美食餐廳,品嚐了一些有趣的菜式,包括用雞的生殖器官製成的日式烤雞串.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw checks out the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo and tastes some interesting dishes including Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師,一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐,一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力,溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沒有多少電影製作人能像史蒂芬史匹柏一樣在業內50多年間如此生生不息和擁有影響力,他從亞利桑那州郊區到好萊塢聚光燈下的旅程是有史以來最偉大的故事之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With over 50 years in the industry, not many filmmakers can boast the longevity and influence of Steven Spielberg, whose journey from the suburbs of Arizona to the spotlight of Hollywood is one of the greatest stories ever told.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自60年前導演的處女作面世,馬丁史柯西斯一生一直致力為電影的過去,現在和未來打拼.他被稱為電影保母,他不斷突破電影製作的極限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 60 years since his directorial debut, Martin Scorseses life has been dedicated to the past, present and future of cinema. Named Caretaker of Cinema, Martin Scorsese continues to push the boundaries of moviemaking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自90年代初,昆汀塔倫提諾一直乘坐從不減速的電影過山車,這也鞏固了他那世上最具影響力的電影製作人之一的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since the early 1990s, Quentin Tarantino has been on a cinematic rollercoaster ride, that’s never looked like slowing down, that has cemented himself as one of the worlds most influential filmmakers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.託森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築--從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索--理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夜間追蹤任務到救援行動,了解MH-6小鳥直昇機如何在其他大型機體中贏得一席之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From night stalker missions to rescue operations, see how the Little Bird helicopter earned its place among the big boys.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the massive military transport aircraft C-5 Galaxy come up big time and again over its five decades of service

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復.我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程.透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The million-year-old, giant Durfort mammoth skeleton required urgent, world-first restoration. We follow the tricky process of disassembling and reassembling the fragile fossil. Through CGI and museum knowledge, the film brings this fascinating, litt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 討人喜歡,被視為滑稽的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂.長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖.少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The endearing, comical puffin is Icelands national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦.他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s first stop on his food trail of South Africa is the bustling city of Cape Town. Here, he visits a lively farmers market and cooks up a Cape Malay Curry in Bo Kaap.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫沿著南非海岸角繼續他的美食之旅,在抵達大森林私人自然保護區前,先到訪卡耶利沙黑人區,那裡是一些具啟發性的微型農業提案的集中地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren continues his food trail along South Africa’s Cape Coast, stopping off at the township of Khayelitsha, home to some inspiring micro-farming initiatives, before arriving at Grootbos Private Nature Reserve.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈裡沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區.然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since the early 1990s, Quentin Tarantino has been on a cinematic rollercoaster ride, that’s never looked like slowing down, that has cemented himself as one of the worlds most influential filmmakers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史派克李一直是位備受爭議和政治性的電影製作人,他的電影就是最好的證據.自40多年前處女作面世,他一直在美國突破界限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spike Lee has always been a controversial and political filmmaker whose films speak for themselves. Over 40 years since his debut in the world of film, Spike continues to push boundaries in America.

epg.programme_title_tc: 拉斐爾納達爾:紅土球王
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片深入探討網球傳奇拉斐爾納達爾的人生,探索他從神童成長為全球巨星的歷程.透過眾多勝利和挑戰揭示拿度在球場內外所貢獻的遺產.(V374)
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary delves into the life of tennis legend Rafael Nadal, exploring his journey from a young prodigy to a global icon. Through triumphs and challenges, it reveals the dedication that defines Nadal’s legacy on and off the court.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖拜登於2021年1月20日就任美國第46任總統,承諾在分裂的時代後團結和鎮靜,目標是恢復美國魂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joe Biden became the 46th US President on Jan 20, 2021, promising unity and calm after a divided era, aiming to restore the soul of America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當川普的總統任期(2017-2021)在一片爭議和社會變革中過渡,對國家和世界產生了良久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Donald Trumps presidency (2017-2021) was marked by controversy and societal shifts, leaving a lasting impact on the nation and world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴拉克歐巴馬是首位非裔美國總統,體現了希望,正義,寬容和平等,以他的信息和傳承啟發數百萬人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barack Obama, the 1st African-American US President, embodied hope, justice, tolerance, and equality, inspiring millions with his message and legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索比爾柯林頓複雜的影響,從阿肯色州起家到白宮的高山(經濟繁榮)與低谷(醜聞,彈劾),以及他對美國政治的影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore Bill Clintons complex legacy, from Arkansas roots to White House highs (economic prosperity) and lows (scandals, impeachment), and his impact on American politics.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭,其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Documentary examines George W. Bushs presidency, focusing on the Iraq War, its aftermath, and the lasting impact of his decisions, including the rise of ISIS and the human toll of the conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 朗奴雷根是一位有魅力的領袖,他用列根經濟學將美國轉營,在國內外有著不同意見,又用他富有遠見的政策和標誌性的演講永遠改變保守主義.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ronald Reagan, a charismatic leader, transformed America with Reaganomics, dividing opinion at home and abroad, and forever changing Conservatism with his visionary policies and iconic speeches.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從小鎮天才到世界第一,這部紀錄片記錄了穆雷追求卓越的堅持,與傷病的搏鬥,以及他作為網壇最具啟發性人物之一的永恆傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town prodigy to World No. 1, Andy Murray: Game Set Match chronicles his relentless pursuit of greatness, his battles with injury, and his enduring legacy as one of tenniss most inspiring figures.

epg.programme_title_tc: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力.在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the massive military transport aircraft C-5 Galaxy come up big time and again over its five decades of service

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看英國蘭卡斯特轟炸機如何出廠並投入行動,對德國進行毀滅性攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the British bomber Lancaster flew out of the factory and into action, leading devastating attacks on Germany.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪:小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈裡沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區.然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he’s staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max’s Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈裡沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見享譽全球的雕塑家佩姬.布拉德利--她親手摧毀自己的藝術作品,只為創造全新的表達.透過火焰與想像,她揭示創作的真諦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art to create something new. Using fire and imagination, Paige offers insight into creativity and the artistic process.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂.羅德裡格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員.馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.託森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築--從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園大道果真是南非的滄海遺珠,它是一條延伸200公裡的沿海公路,以其迷人的多樣性和無出其右的荒野而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫抵達開普敦,這不會是這座城市的平凡美食探索之旅;華倫在整集節目中致力深入研究南非一種特殊的烹飪風格- 開普馬來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren has arrived into Cape Town. This won’t be your average culinary exploration of a city; Warren has dedicated the entire episode to diving into a specific style of South African cooking known as 『Cape Malay』.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在法蘭史霍克山谷探索博殊真度紅酒莊的無盡產物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the Franschhoek Valley, exploring the endless bounty of Boschendal Wine Estate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫繼續從心出發,前往更鮮為人知的赫爾馬努斯小鎮,在當地參觀紐頓莊臣-風景優美的紅酒農場,從而加深對紅酒的熱愛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Continuing to listen to his heart, Warren deepens his love of wine by venturing to the lesser known town of Hermanus, where he』ll visit Newton Johnson, the 『wine farm with a view』.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫正離開開普敦前往西開普省更寧靜的沿海地區和風景如畫的帕特諾斯特小鎮.他在當地會驚嘆海邊村莊的氛圍,並沿著海灘騎電動單車.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is heading out of Cape Town into the more quiet coastal area of the Western Cape, and the picturesque town of Paternoster. It’s here he』ll marvel at the seaside village feel and take an e-bike ride along the beach.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 作為華倫南非美食之旅的最後一章,他回歸叢林,這是所有前往彩虹國度旅行的精髓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the final stanza in Warren’s Food Trail of South Africa, he’s back in the bush, a quintessential part of all travel to the rainbow nation.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努費德的夢想是追隨儒勒凡爾納《80 天環遊世界》的腳步.因此,他為自己立下挑戰,要用他熱愛美食的眼界來環遊世界.他能成功嗎? 第一站-倫敦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu Feildel has a dream to follow in the footsteps of Jules Vernes』 Around the World in 80 days. So Manu sets himself a challenge to circumnavigate the world, through his food loving eyes. Will he make it? First stop - London.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努在倫敦之後來到杜拜,很快就在當地累積了豐富的煮食經驗,因此他出發前往香料市場,魚市場和當地的甜品廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu arrives in Dubai after London and is quick to dig up as much culinary experience in Dubai so he sets off to the spice souk, fish markets and a local pastry kitchen.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努生平首次到訪印度,他想發現盡量多的食物.從蒸米漿糕的製作課程,到加爾各答花卉市場的鍛鍊.他能準時,完好無缺地到達香港嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu is in India for the first time in his life and wants to discover as much food as he can handle. From an Idli making lesson to a workout in the flower markets of Kolkata. Will he make it to Hong Kong on time and in one piece?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary offers an intimate and comprehensive journey through the extraordinary career of Lionel Messi - from his humble beginnings in Rosario, Argentina, to becoming a global football icon.

epg.programme_title_tc: 克林伊斯威特:自得其樂
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇連伊士活是一個演員,導演和慈善家.從典型的西方偶像,到磨練他的技藝和關懷的個性.這就是他波瀾壯闊的人生故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Clint Eastwood, Actor, director and philanthropist. From being the quintessential western icon, to honing his artistic skills and caring persona. This is his magnificent story.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is heading out of Cape Town into the more quiet coastal area of the Western Cape, and the picturesque town of Paternoster. It’s here he』ll marvel at the seaside village feel and take an e-bike ride along the beach.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 作為華倫南非美食之旅的最後一章,他回歸叢林,這是所有前往彩虹國度旅行的精髓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the final stanza in Warren’s Food Trail of South Africa, he’s back in the bush, a quintessential part of all travel to the rainbow nation.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努費德的夢想是追隨儒勒凡爾納《80 天環遊世界》的腳步.因此,他為自己立下挑戰,要用他熱愛美食的眼界來環遊世界.他能成功嗎? 第一站-倫敦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu Feildel has a dream to follow in the footsteps of Jules Vernes』 Around the World in 80 days. So Manu sets himself a challenge to circumnavigate the world, through his food loving eyes. Will he make it? First stop - London.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努在倫敦之後來到杜拜,很快就在當地累積了豐富的煮食經驗,因此他出發前往香料市場,魚市場和當地的甜品廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu arrives in Dubai after London and is quick to dig up as much culinary experience in Dubai so he sets off to the spice souk, fish markets and a local pastry kitchen.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努生平首次到訪印度,他想發現盡量多的食物.從蒸米漿糕的製作課程,到加爾各答花卉市場的鍛鍊.他能準時,完好無缺地到達香港嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu is in India for the first time in his life and wants to discover as much food as he can handle. From an Idli making lesson to a workout in the flower markets of Kolkata. Will he make it to Hong Kong on time and in one piece?

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努費德的夢想是追隨儒勒凡爾納《80 天環遊世界》的腳步.因此,他為自己立下挑戰,要用他熱愛美食的眼界來環遊世界.他能成功嗎? 第一站-倫敦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu Feildel has a dream to follow in the footsteps of Jules Vernes』 Around the World in 80 days. So Manu sets himself a challenge to circumnavigate the world, through his food loving eyes. Will he make it? First stop - London.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈裡沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫來到歷史名城普利托利亞,到訪當地農夫市集,與糕點師郎高斯一起製作扭麻條(南非糯冬甩).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren stops off at the historic city of Pretoria, where he visits the local farmers markets and cooks Koeksisters - South African sticky donuts - with Pastry Chef Nonkosi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰尼斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維託小鎮.導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車 遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He’s taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦.他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s first stop on his food trail of South Africa is the bustling city of Cape Town. Here, he visits a lively farmers market and cooks up a Cape Malay Curry in Bo Kaap.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫沿著南非海岸角繼續他的美食之旅,在抵達大森林私人自然保護區前,先到訪卡耶利沙黑人區,那裡是一些具啟發性的微型農業提案的集中地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren continues his food trail along South Africa’s Cape Coast, stopping off at the township of Khayelitsha, home to some inspiring micro-farming initiatives, before arriving at Grootbos Private Nature Reserve.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.託森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築--從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索--理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在紐西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.programme_title_en: Gameplay: The Story Of The Videogame Revolution
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片.歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光.從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gameplay is a feature on the history of videogames. From Pong to Pac Man, Super Mario to Lara Croft, Doom, Grand Theft Auto and beyond, we chronicle the remarkable story of the fastest evolving new media of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.programme_title_tc: 克林伊斯威特:自得其樂
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇連伊士活是一個演員,導演和慈善家.從典型的西方偶像,到磨練他的技藝和關懷的個性.這就是他波瀾壯闊的人生故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Clint Eastwood, Actor, director and philanthropist. From being the quintessential western icon, to honing his artistic skills and caring persona. This is his magnificent story.

epg.programme_title_tc: 瑪麗亞凱莉:毅力與魅力
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪麗亞.凱莉的人生宛如童話般的灰姑娘故事.至尊歌后,聖誕女王,熱心公益的慈善家--她已售出超過 2.2 億張唱片,並推出史上最暢銷的聖誕專輯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Cinderella story of sorts, Mariah Carey. Songbird Supreme. Queen of Christmas. Dedicated philanthropist. Mariah has sold over 220 million records and released the best-selling Christmas album ever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從地下俱樂部到全球巨星,《女神卡卡:為舞而生》探索這位重新定義音樂,時尚與名聲的流行偶像勢不可擋的崛起之路.在勝利與挫折交織的人生中,見證卡卡如何以舞步迎戰挑戰,並最終勝出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From underground clubs to global superstardom, Lady Gaga: Dance or Die explores the unstoppable rise of the pop icon who redefined music, fashion, and fame. Through triumphs and tribulations, witness how Gaga danced through life’s challenges - and wo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dr. Matt pays his weekly visit to Flamingoland, near Malton in North Yorkshire, and is called to inspect a new arrival, a male Asian Sarus Crane brought in as company to a resident female. They are an endangered species but the cranes haven't yet warmed to each other and Matt offers advice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property. Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur. One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: SpongeBob's pet is Gary the Snail! Which cute pet has characteristics of both Gary and Mr. Krabs? "Cute Pet Guide" wants to introduce you to these little guys with shells on their backs - hermit crabs: as their bodies grow, they must shed their shells and move to new homes. In addition to that, there are many little-known secrets of them waiting for you to explore!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
As the world is gradually turning more vegetarian, and its metropolitan cities are
adopting more juice and salad bars into their restaurant culture, Samira heads
back to India to explore its vast vegetarian cuisine and its origins…

In this episode, Samira traces the roots of vegetarianism in India, in temples as food for the gods, solves the mystery of the giant family paper Dosa, gives healthy tips and tricks on quick and easy vegetarian snacks and explores the amazing Teas of India and ends up cooking some delicious Indian fritters to go with her cup of cha!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Indian food isn't just all beaten copper pots and traditional curry. In this episode, we look at all the innovations in modern Indian cuisine. There are chefs in India pushing the envelope and Samira gets invited into the kitchens of some of India's top Avant Garde chefs, who create exotic twists to three quintessential Indian dishes.

Samira's tryst for all things beautiful, guides her towards modernist Indian food, where flavours of the subcontinent meet new age culinary techniques in cooking and plating.

There are enough tips for the home chef to try at home. Samira tries her own hand with new ideas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Indian food is becoming a staple in most big cities around the world. But its desserts have taken a back seat to some of its popular main courses. Samira finds out all about the spectacular buffet of desserts India has to offer, before making some in her own kitchen. Telling her viewers, the history of Indian sweets starting with its beginnings as devotional, spiritual temple food for the Gods, before learning how to make them. She ends up back home in New York eating cupcakes from one of her favorite bakeries in Times Square.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Indian food isn't just all beaten copper pots and traditional curry. In this episode, we look at all the innovations in modern Indian cuisine. There are chefs in India pushing the envelope and Samira gets invited into the kitchens of some of India's top Avant Garde chefs, who create exotic twists to three quintessential Indian dishes.

Samira's tryst for all things beautiful, guides her towards modernist Indian food, where flavours of the subcontinent meet new age culinary techniques in cooking and plating.

There are enough tips for the home chef to try at home. Samira tries her own hand with new ideas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: “Miracle Venom” explores the strange, and often bizarre world of the oceans most venomous animals. Follow Dr. Glen Burns as he handles deadly Sea Snakes with only his bare hands. You'll be amazed at how a small Cone Snail hunts, paralyses and then eats its prey alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In this episode, we examine how every animal has what could be called a sense of rhythm – the human animal included. To give an obvious example, there’s our internal body clock which responds to the so-called Circadian rhythm. That’s the 24 hour night and day cycle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re not whales at all, but by far the largest fish in the sea. Yet at nearly 50 feet in length and weighing 20 tons or more, they eat only the smallest marine animals. From Africa to Asia, they are targeted for their meat and immense fins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In this episode of Animal Super Senses, we find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground... and find out how their senses are tuned to survive. What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world, …a busy, complex web of life lies just beneath our feet. Fossorial animals are well adapted to life underground.  They live in burrows, tunnels, and mounds using the earth, or whatever substrate they live in, to build their homes, find their food and friends, and stay safe from enemies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In this episode of Animal Super Senses, we find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground... and find out how their senses are tuned to survive. What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world, …a busy, complex web of life lies just beneath our feet. Fossorial animals are well adapted to life underground.  They live in burrows, tunnels, and mounds using the earth, or whatever substrate they live in, to build their homes, find their food and friends, and stay safe from enemies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Singing louder than any animal on earth, humpback whales are famous for their haunting songs and jaw-dropping acrobatics. Only you won’t believe how some animals see the world....

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Shark Gordon's off to the Sea of Cortez to after his next quarry. Dive in and see the wonder of an underwater mountain as Gordon and his crew scour it for the elusive schools of hammerheads.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: All fish have moveable jaws and are covered in scales, using gills to breath underwater. Many forming schools or shoals based on social structure, it’s a unique group arrangement with many benefits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: “Shark Business” unravels some of the mysteries surrounding sharks with controversial behaviorist Dr. Erich Ritter. You'll witness divers testing the limits of shark-human interaction outside of cages with dangerous sharks such as lemon, bull and even great white sharks!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Renowned herpetologist Nirut Chomngam takes viewers on a wild journey across the country in an unforgettable adventure filled with deadly encounters, as he joins conservation teams tasked with protecting these astonishing creatures and their jungle home.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned herpetologist Nirut Chomngam takes viewers on a wild journey across the country in an unforgettable adventure filled with deadly encounters, as he joins conservation teams tasked with protecting these astonishing creatures and their jungle home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we get in touch with the feelings of wild animals. Really in touch. Because animals, just like humans, rely heavily on their sense of touch, every day in every way. There may be a fine line between pleasure and pain, but not knowing the difference between the two can be absolutely fatal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans. This episode is all about those ‘super human’ senses – animal sensory systems that can detect magnetic fields (magneto- reception), electric fields (electroreception) and infrared radiation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Our closest relatives, primates are a diverse group of highly intelligent mammals. Over 440 species, with varied social structures and behaviours, explore chimpanzee’s, gorillas, orangutan and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: “Tentacles” follows Dr. Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean Island of Bonaire. Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re not whales at all, but by far the largest fish in the sea. Yet at nearly 50 feet in length and weighing 20 tons or more, they eat only the smallest marine animals. They are not a threat to humans, but their numbers are dramatically shrinking. Like elephants slaughtered for their ivory tusks, whale sharks are relentlessly pursued by poachers. From Africa to Asia, they are targeted for their meat and immense fins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troubles.Real people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life.
From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: As Russia faces growing international isolation, loyalists within the 30 million-strong Russian diaspora are dedicated to defending, supporting and promoting Putin overseas. Vladimir Putin has made it clear that he wants Russia to reclaim its former glory: across the globe, Russians echo his sentiment, shutting down critics of the Kremlin. From jeering newspaper articles, to counter-protestors staring down protestors who condemn the jailing of Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny, Putin's international supporters are a force to be reckoned with.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A father, a criminal. A son seeking peace. Two victims' sons. One story of revenge and reconciliation, told by their children.

epg.programme_title_tc: Ganz: How I Lost My Beetle
epg.programme_title_en: Ganz: How I Lost My Beetle
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Volkswagen Beetle is a design classic. Celebrated by the Nazis, and championed by Hitler, the Beetle's true origins were obscured by a web of intrigue, espionage and slander. This extraordinary doc reveals the untold story of Josef Ganz, the Jewish visionary behind one of the world's most adored cars. As relatives search for traces of Ganz's legacy, they seek to recover the genius of a man edited out of history.

Vladimir Putin has made it clear that he wants Russia to reclaim its former glory: across the globe, Russians echo his sentiment, shutting down critics of the Kremlin. From jeering newspaper articles, to counter-protestors staring down protestors who condemn the jailing of Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny, Putin's international supporters are a force to be reckoned with.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A father, a criminal. A son seeking peace. Two victims' sons. One story of revenge and reconciliation, told by their children.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A father, a criminal. A son seeking peace. Two victims' sons. One story of revenge and reconciliation, told by their children.

epg.programme_title_tc: Ganz: How I Lost My Beetle
epg.programme_title_en: Ganz: How I Lost My Beetle
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Volkswagen Beetle is a design classic. Celebrated by the Nazis, and championed by Hitler, the Beetle's true origins were obscured by a web of intrigue, espionage and slander. This extraordinary doc reveals the untold story of Josef Ganz, the Jewish visionary behind one of the world's most adored cars. As relatives search for traces of Ganz's legacy, they seek to recover the genius of a man edited out of history.

A timeless and poignant recounting of young lives sacrificed in wartime.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A compelling testimony to the possibilities of local activism, this environmental thriller follows investigative journalist, Matt Blomberg, and ocean activist, Paul Ferber, in their dangerous efforts to create a marine conservation area and combat the relentless tide of illegal fishing in Southeast Asia. Along the way a new generation of Cambodian environmentalists are inspired to create a better life for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Eco-activist Rod Coronado has made it his life's mission to advocate for the planet and the rights of animals. In 2014 he formed Wolf Patrol, an activist group which fights to end hunting of the grey wolves that roam Wisconsin’s forests. After 30 years of radical environmental action, which earned him the label 'eco-terrorist' and spells in prison, this intimate documentary follows Rod's journey to redefine his activism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A compelling testimony to the possibilities of local activism, this environmental thriller follows investigative journalist, Matt Blomberg, and ocean activist, Paul Ferber, in their dangerous efforts to create a marine conservation area and combat the relentless tide of illegal fishing in Southeast Asia. Along the way a new generation of Cambodian environmentalists are inspired to create a better life for their people.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A compelling testimony to the possibilities of local activism, this environmental thriller follows investigative journalist, Matt Blomberg, and ocean activist, Paul Ferber, in their dangerous efforts to create a marine conservation area and combat the relentless tide of illegal fishing in Southeast Asia. Along the way a new generation of Cambodian environmentalists are inspired to create a better life for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Eco-activist Rod Coronado has made it his life's mission to advocate for the planet and the rights of animals. In 2014 he formed Wolf Patrol, an activist group which fights to end hunting of the grey wolves that roam Wisconsin’s forests. After 30 years of radical environmental action, which earned him the label 'eco-terrorist' and spells in prison, this intimate documentary follows Rod's journey to redefine his activism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Among Dazu’s carved Buddhas, a mysterious figure sits. Its many arms hold a secret only one lone monk unraveled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troubles.Real people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dimitri is Fish Captain in Trouville-sur-Mer, Normandy. accompanied with his deckhands, Joris and Omar, embarked on a trawler, they track fishes… Far from their families from Monday to Friday, in the harshness of the job, they face the whims of the sea. Welcome aboard of “La Persévérance

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The darkness, the muffled noises, holding your breath until the very last minute: this documentary plunges into the world of free diving. Lakes, rivers, oceans - the abyss is a source of fascination for Igor. Travelling from Switzerland to the world’s deepest blue hole in the Caribbean, Igor starts to compete and is crowned Swiss champion of free diving, descending to 82 metres.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bob and Nancy Griffith made twenty ocean voyages over two decades, fulfilling a dream of freedom and adventure in their 53-foot sailboat. Nothing seemed impossible for this couple and their growing family as they travelled to some of the most remote places on earth, chronicling life at sea with their 16mm Bolex camera. As narrated by Nancy in this extraordinary film, their unconventional life’s voyage brought unexpected challenges and sacrifices.

As narrated by Nancy in this extraordinary film, their unconventional life’s voyage brought unexpected challenges and sacrifices.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On board a sleeper train crossing Tanzania, the stories of three passengers unfold. Rukia is an entrepreneurial woman, on her way to begin a new life. Isaya is an old Masai man heading back to the bush with his grandson. Peter, a powerful preacher, makes money by letting his followers pay for his services. This microcosm offers a glimpse into their lives as each character moves towards an uncertain future in this precarious society.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troubles.Real people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life.
From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Amazon plays a vital part in regulating the planet’s temperature. And yet, in the last year, forest destruction in the Brazilian Amazon soared by 85 per cent. The combination of illegal logging and slash and burn agriculture is decimating the land. With huge profits to be made, the Amazon is a dangerous place to ask questions. Despite the threat, the Amazonian tribes want the world to hear their message.

Despite the threat, the Amazonian tribes want the world to hear their message.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Deep In The Heart follows four patients, Lisa, Ted, Greg and Pat, as they deal with the emotional drama of major life-saving surgery. It’s an emotional story familiar to families up and down the country: skilled surgeons can fix bodies, but it’s up to the patients to make sure it doesn’t all go wrong again. All four face pressure from their families to come out of denial and face reality. Can they turn their lives around and quit the habits of a lifetime?

All four face pressure from their families to come out of denial and face reality. Can they turn their lives around and quit the habits of a lifetime?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Psychologist and filmmaker Eve always thought there was something not quite right about her family. After a decade of searching for the truth about her mother's roots as a Polish holocaust survivor, Eve makes a remarkable discovery about a chance encounter that changed her life forever. A compelling tale of two defining human traits — endurance and frailty — and a metaphor for the 20th century’s most painful trauma.

From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Amazon plays a vital part in regulating the planet’s temperature. And yet, in the last year, forest destruction in the Brazilian Amazon soared by 85 per cent. The combination of illegal logging and slash and burn agriculture is decimating the land. With huge profits to be made, the Amazon is a dangerous place to ask questions. Despite the threat, the Amazonian tribes want the world to hear their message.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Deep In The Heart follows four patients, Lisa, Ted, Greg and Pat, as they deal with the emotional drama of major life-saving surgery. It’s an emotional story familiar to families up and down the country: skilled surgeons can fix bodies, but it’s up to the patients to make sure it doesn’t all go wrong again. All four face pressure from their families to come out of denial and face reality. Can they turn their lives around and quit the habits of a lifetime?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Psychologist and filmmaker Eve always thought there was something not quite right about her family. After a decade of searching for the truth about her mother's roots as a Polish holocaust survivor, Eve makes a remarkable discovery about a chance encounter that changed her life forever. A compelling tale of two defining human traits — endurance and frailty — and a metaphor for the 20th century’s most painful trauma.

epg.programme_title_tc: Inside Facebook - Secrets of A Social Network
epg.programme_title_en: Inside Facebook - Secrets of A Social Network
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Banning its news feature in Australia, Facebook draws international condemnation. But how does the social media giant regulate its content, in an era marked by insidious fake news? This alarming documentary offers unique undercover access to Facebook’s moderating hub. It presents a disturbing picture of an organisation putting money before morality and for whom extreme content equals extreme profits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A documentary exploring the muralist movement: the art of painting over breathtaking heights. Windowless gable walls were graffiti painters’ early targets, particularly in urban areas under renovation, and since 2012, monumental graffiti is in full rebirth especially in Paris’ 13th arrondissement. Through a design thought as a décor, obliterating the blandness of the walls, artists skillfully revive these soulless surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Afghanistan's first ski team reach for a brighter future Where the Light ShinesFrom their amateur efforts at home in the Bamyan peaks, Sajjad and Alishah have the chance to ski for Afghanistan in the Winter Olympics. As local kids strap wood to their feet and imitate their heroes, the men face up to the difficulty of creating opportunities in a country that for generations has only seen war. Filmed over four years, this beautiful film paints an uplifting and refreshing portrait of Afghanistan as you haven't seen it before.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Cruise ships gave coronavirus a free ride around the world this Spring. While infected passengers think the Ruby Princess should be sailed out to sea and sunk, its owner company is busy marketing post-Covid cruises. Far from protecting people, the release of the ship’s passengers onto Australian shores triggered a public health emergency with the Ruby Princess now named as the single largest source of Australia’s coronavirus infections. Tracey Temple, a passenger with underlying health conditions, is adamant that Princess Cruises forewent their duty of care. “As far as I’m concerned, they never put our safety first”. Pleas for information were met with reassurance from staff that “this ship is virus free”. The cruise liner was ultimately called back to Sydney, but not before the virus had spread unchecked among the passengers, and unchallenged by social distancing measures. Unaware of the public health disaster they were carrying, the passengers then dissipated not only across Australia, but the world. “We thought we were going into the problem; we didn’t realise we were the problem,” says another passenger. 850 passengers and crew from the ship contracted the virus,and at least 26 died.

epg.programme_title_tc: Ganz: How I Lost My Beetle
epg.programme_title_en: Ganz: How I Lost My Beetle
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Volkswagen Beetle is a design classic. Celebrated by the Nazis, and championed by Hitler, the Beetle's true origins were obscured by a web of intrigue, espionage and slander. This extraordinary doc reveals the untold story of Josef Ganz, the Jewish visionary behind one of the world's most adored cars. As relatives search for traces of Ganz's legacy, they seek to recover the genius of a man edited out of history.

From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Exposing the world’s most convincing, creative, and criminally-adept con-men, Serial Swindlers goes inside their minds. While their crimes and exploits are a ready-made Hollywood script, their exploits have left a trail of heartache, poverty and destruction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: As Russia faces growing international isolation, loyalists within the 30 million-strong Russian diaspora are dedicated to defending, supporting and promoting Putin overseas. Vladimir Putin has made it clear that he wants Russia to reclaim its former glory: across the globe, Russians echo his sentiment, shutting down critics of the Kremlin. From jeering newspaper articles, to counter-protestors staring down protestors who condemn the jailing of Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny, Putin's international supporters are a force to be reckoned with.

epg.programme_title_tc: Ganz: How I Lost My Beetle
epg.programme_title_en: Ganz: How I Lost My Beetle
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Volkswagen Beetle is a design classic. Celebrated by the Nazis, and championed by Hitler, the Beetle's true origins were obscured by a web of intrigue, espionage and slander. This extraordinary doc reveals the untold story of Josef Ganz, the Jewish visionary behind one of the world's most adored cars. As relatives search for traces of Ganz's legacy, they seek to recover the genius of a man edited out of history.

As relatives search for traces of Ganz's legacy, they seek to recover the genius of a man edited out of history.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Incredible footage from ordinary Australians captured the ferocity of the bushfires that raged across the country this summer. These videos have been viewed tens of millions of times across the world, but who filmed them and how did their stories end? A team of reporters and producers fanned out across the country to track down the people who found themselves in the centre of the firestorms. What emerges are incredible stories of survival, bravery and heartbreak.

What emerges are incredible stories of survival, bravery and heartbreak.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In the uplands of North East England, Tom and Kay Hutchinson set out on a near impossible task: to breed the perfect Swaledale Sheep. They toil through sun, hail, sleet and snow to rear their flock. Life on the fells is by turns idyllic and tough. Surrounded by an ever-changing and stunning landscape, the family battle against the weather, financial challenges and the bizarre propensity of sheep to suddenly drop dead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: During World War Two, Czechoslovakian airmen fought across the world. Defending the Allied Power's skies, they even played an integral role in the Battle of Britain. This is the story of two Czech men who served in Britain's RAF - yet on return to their home country, a hero's welcome merges into persecution, as the communist party seizes power. A timeless and poignant recounting of young lives sacrificed in wartime.

epg.programme_title_en: Late Night With Seth Meyers S13 # 119
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯梅耶斯深夜秀由艾美獎得主洛恩米高斯監製,邀請一線紅星作嘉賓,還有難忘的喜劇和最棒的音樂人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Late Night with Seth Meyers is executive produced by the Emmy Award-winning Lorne Michaels and is home to A-list celebrity guests, memorable comedy and the best in musical talent.

epg.programme_title_en: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon S13 # 150
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾美獎及格林美獎得主兼喜劇演員吉米法倫以好客的訪問風格,觀眾投入度,精準的模仿和創新的短劇,將他獨特的高能爆笑喜劇引進NBC的60年傳奇系列.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emmy and Grammy Award-winning comedian Jimmy Fallon brings his unique high-energy comedy to the storied 60-year NBC franchise with his welcoming interview style, love of audience participation, spot-on impersonations and innovative sketches.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這場超現實歌唱節目將迎來雙重揭面!頂尖名人們竭盡所能隱藏真實身分.準備好迎接驚人的揭曉時刻,我們不禁要問:面具背後的到底是誰?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s a double unmasking in the surreal singing show where huge celebrities compete to keep their true identities hidden. Expect amazing reveals as we ask, “who is behind the mask?”

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一檔超現實歌唱節目,頂尖名人們在其中隱藏身分,祕密競技,守護著真實身分不被發現.準備好迎接令人目瞪口呆的揭曉時刻,我們不禁要問:面具背後的到底是誰?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s the surreal singing show where huge celebrities compete undercover, keeping their true identities hidden. Expect jaw-dropping reveals as we ask, “who is behind the mask?”

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2026年SPOTV K-Pop Awards(9月6日於KINTEX)是一項結合Circle Chart數據與歌迷投票的全球音樂盛典.由SPOTV與BIGC聯合主辦,屆時將有大批新世代藝人及頂尖韓流頒獎嘉賓陣容齊聚一堂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 2026 SPOTV K-Pop Awards (Sept 6, KINTEX) is a global music ceremony blending Circle Chart data with fan voting. Jointly organized by SPOTV and BIGC, the event features a massive lineup of next-gen artists and top Hallyu presenters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 托利斯收到占美女兒的短信,說她在海軍圖書館附近發現了大量現金,小隊一起展開調查.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Torres receives a text from Jimmy’s daughter who has discovered a large sum of money near the naval library, the team works together to investigate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名海軍中尉的死亡被揭發與特務梳也(星荷茲飾)有關,托利斯和麗特發現一宗與豪門有關的謀殺案.另外,帕加發現母親的死與莉莉之間有著驚人的關聯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a Navy Lieutenant’s death reveals ties to Special Agent Sawyer (Zane Holtz), Torres and Knight uncover a murder linked to a wealthy family. Meanwhile, Parker discovers a shocking connection between his mother’s death and Lily.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海軍罪案調查局接到電話調查一名縱火疑犯的動機,讓一場女孩之夜發生意想不到的轉折.另外,托利斯也努力尋找工作與生活的平衡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A girls’ night out takes an unexpected turn when NCIS is called to investigate the motive of a possible arsonist. Also, Torres struggles to find work/life balance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一檔超現實歌唱節目,頂尖名人們在其中隱藏身分,祕密競技,守護著真實身分不被發現.準備好迎接令人目瞪口呆的揭曉時刻,我們不禁要問:面具背後的到底是誰?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s the surreal singing show where huge celebrities compete undercover, keeping their true identities hidden. Expect jaw-dropping reveals as we ask, “who is behind the mask?”

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個小鎮決定對困擾該鎮的黄色胡蜂使用一種非常有效但未經測試的殺蟲劑.不過,該物種現已變異,變得更強壯,更具攻擊性,更飢餓,並且對活人肉感興趣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A small town decides to use a very potent and untested pesticide on yellow-jacket wasps plaguing the town However, the species has now mutated and is now stronger, more aggressive, hungrier and interested in LIVE human meat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正在渡假的花栗鼠與花栗妹把豪華郵輪當成了個人樂園,直到他們大鬧郵輪並意外流落荒島.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The vacationing Chipmunks and Chipettes are turning a luxury cruise liner into their personal playground, until they become chipwrecked on a remote island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三隻會唱流行歌的花栗鼠--艾爾文,賽門與喜多,徹底將一位落魄詞曲創作者的生活搞得天翻地覆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pop-singer Chipmunks Alvin, Simon and Theodore turn a songwriters life upside-down.

epg.programme_title_en: Alvin And The Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾爾文,賽門和喜多回歸,展開另一場爆笑的音樂冒險!但這一次,他們可能會遇到勁敵--由三隻母花栗鼠組成的合唱組合鼠美眉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alvin, Simon and Theodore return for another hilarious musical adventure, but this time they may just meet their match - a singing trio of female chipmunks called The Chipettes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 賽巴斯汀與蜜亞因共同追尋熱愛的夢想而相遇相知,然而隨著成功逐步到來,他們努力守護的夢想,卻也開始威脅著將兩人分開.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sebastian and Mia are drawn together by their common desire to do what they love. But as success builds, the dreams they worked so hard to maintain threaten to rip them apart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個家庭從他們那隻可愛卻調皮,神經質的愛犬身上,學到了重要的人生課題.本片改編自約翰·葛羅根的同名回憶錄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A family learns important life lessons from their adorable, but naughty and neurotic, dog. Based on the memoir by John Grogan.

epg.programme_title_en: Spy Kids: All The Time In The World
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 時間所剩無多!退休間諜瑪莉莎(潔西卡·艾巴 飾)重出江湖,當一名反派威脅要讓全世界陷入冰封危機時,她必須再次出擊!在繼子女的協助與各種酷炫裝備的幫助下,他們展開一場與時間賽跑的精彩冒險--這是一部充滿動作與家庭樂趣的3D 王牌小間諜電影!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The action packed franchise is back...with the next generation of Spy Kids!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Things become tense when Knight is assigned to protect his wife after the home of a high-level defense contractor is attacked.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一檔超現實歌唱節目,頂尖名人們在其中隱藏身分,祕密競技,守護著真實身分不被發現.準備好迎接令人目瞪口呆的揭曉時刻,我們不禁要問:面具背後的到底是誰?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s the surreal singing show where huge celebrities compete undercover, keeping their true identities hidden. Expect jaw-dropping reveals as we ask, “who is behind the mask?”

epg.programme_title_en: Spy Kids: All The Time In The World
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 時間所剩無多!退休間諜瑪莉莎(潔西卡·艾巴 飾)重出江湖,當一名反派威脅要讓全世界陷入冰封危機時,她必須再次出擊!在繼子女的協助與各種酷炫裝備的幫助下,他們展開一場與時間賽跑的精彩冒險--這是一部充滿動作與家庭樂趣的3D 王牌小間諜電影!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The action packed franchise is back...with the next generation of Spy Kids!

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 1
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬艾琳和蘿西因凱莉不尋常的感情傳聞產生衝突.新搬到羅德島的艾希莉努力融入這群關係深厚的朋友.在喬艾琳的國慶派對上,小鎮的秘密紛紛浮出水面.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jo-Ellen and Rosie clash over Kelseys relationship. Newcomer Ashley tries to fit in with a tight-knit group. Small-town secrets surface during Jo-Ellens Fourth of July party.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 2
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾希莉透露了傑瑞德因經營咖啡店所承受的壓力.露拉指責喬艾琳散布關於外遇的謠言.凱莉邀請大家前往紐波特酒莊品酒,試圖藉此平息眾人的流言蜚語.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ashley shares Jareds stress over their coffee shop. Rulla accuses Jo-Ellen of spreading affair rumors. Kelsey invites the group to a Newport Winery tasting to squash the gossip.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 3
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 露拉舉辦黎巴嫩午宴並向好友尋求建議.艾莉西亞向莉茲傾訴對婚姻的恐懼.艾希莉與傑瑞德嘗試約會.在 Studio 54 主題派對上,露拉,喬艾琳及其丈夫們正面交鋒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rulla seeks advice at a Lebanese lunch. Alicia tells Liz her fears about marriage. Ashley and Jared try a date night. At a Studio 54 party, Rulla and Jo-Ellen’s husbands face off.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 4
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在激烈爭吵後,凱莉與莉茲被迫正視友誼中的問題.艾莉西亞的姨媽們就婚姻問題給了露拉一些建議.女士們參加火車旅行,卻意外導致另一段友誼面臨破裂危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kelsey and Liz confront their friendship issues after a fight. Alicia’s aunts advise Rulla on her marriage. A railroad excursion ends with another friendship on the verge of derailing.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 5
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女士們出海航行,正式解決了蘿西與凱莉之間積壓已久的緊張關係.喬艾琳與露拉見面希望能達成停戰.布萊恩在馬球場上的可疑行為引發了一場令人震驚的對峙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The ladies go sailing, where Rosie and Kelsey address their tension. Jo-Ellen and Rulla attempt a truce. Brian’s behavior at polo leads to a shocking confrontation.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 6
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 眾人在紐波特的歷史豪宅共度週末.艾莉西亞籌劃的茶會邀請了神祕嘉賓,令眾人滿腹疑問.莉茲舉辦假面晚宴揭開真相.凱莉震驚宣布感情現狀,並就傳聞與蘿西對質.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The group stays at a Newport mansion. Alicia’s tea party guests spark questions. At a masquerade dinner, Kelsey shares relationship news and confronts Rosie about surprising rumors.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 7
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在紐波特的第二天,Rosie 與 Kelsey 進行私下對話,試圖解決她們不穩定的關係.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Day two in Newport, Rosie and Kelsey sit down for a one-on-one to address their rocky relationship.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 8
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬-艾倫與母親進行了一場談心.在與露拉的晚餐中,艾莉西亞必須決定自己究竟要維持表面和平,還是揭發真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jo-Ellen has a heart-to-heart with her mother. Alicia must decide if she wants to keep the peace or expose the truth during dinner with Rulla.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 9
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 9
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾希莉在奧黛麗餐廳主持益智問答之夜時,被夾在一場恩怨之中.艾莉西亞則為比薩媽媽(Pizza Mamma)提出了創新的商業點子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ashley is caught in the middle of a feud while hosting trivia night at Audreys. Alicia pitches business ideas for Pizza Mamma.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 10
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 10
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在瑞奇表演的第一排,莉茲和喬·艾倫也帶來了她們自己令人難忘的演出.艾希莉和傑瑞德在思考奧黛麗的未來.凱爾西和比爾則討論了他們的關係現狀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While front row at Rich’s show, Liz and Jo-Ellen give an unforgettable performance of their own. Ashley and Jared contemplate the future of Audrey’s. Kelsey and Bill discuss the status of their relationship.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 11
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 11
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 露拉和布萊恩舉辦了一場夏末天方夜譚派對,老朋友們在波士頓那個火爆之夜後首次面對面.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rulla and Brian host an end-of-summer Arabian Nights party where old friends come face-to-face for the first time since the explosive night in Boston.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 12
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 12
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱爾西組織了一次前往布洛克島的旅行,希望能讓大家重聚,但莉茲和喬·艾倫依然不和.艾莉西亞和比利重新審視了他們的婚約.露拉則面臨著另一場公開醜聞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kelsey hosts a trip to Block Island in hopes of bringing the group back together, but Liz and Jo-Ellen are still on the outs. Alicia and Billy revisit their engagement. Rulla is faced with another public scandal.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 13
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 13
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 羅德島的女士們與安迪·科恩坐下來座談,討論她們的第一季,並深入探討她們的個人關係.蘿西和凱爾西因震驚的新指控而正面交鋒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The women of Rhode Island sit down with Andy Cohen to discuss their very first season and dive deeper into their personal relationships. Rosie and Kelsey face off with shocking new allegations.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅德島州貴婦的真實生活 # 14
epg.programme_title_en: The Real Housewives Of Rhode Island # 14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女士們的另一半也來到台上,一同討論這一季的起起落落.傑瑞和莉茲回應了關於他們婚姻的傳言.比利向艾莉西亞提出了一種全新的求婚方式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The ladies are joined by their significant others on stage to discuss the ups and downs of the season. Gerry and Liz address the rumors about their marriage. Billy makes a new kind of proposal to Alicia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《一日三餐》系列開播10周年之際以新一季回歸。車勝元、柳海真再次體驗自給自足的山村生活,與驚喜嘉賓享受簡單又美味的料理。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 3 Meals A Day returns on its 10th anniversary. Cha Seung-won and Yoo Hae-jin will experience a self-sufficient village life again and enjoy simple yet fulfilling meals with surprise guests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《一日三餐》系列開播10周年之際以新一季回歸。車勝元、柳海真再次體驗自給自足的山村生活,與驚喜嘉賓享受簡單又美味的料理。

epg.programme_title_tc: 行李變變變:四人一箱去旅行 #1

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When his older brother goes missing in Afghanistan, Tommy, the familys black-sheep, begins to care for his sister-in-law and nieces with consequences that will shake the foundation of the entire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 聚焦全球大事,從華府到北京,從歐美到亞非,從政治、經濟到科技與文化,透過深度而完整的報導,帶領觀眾進入關鍵事件的核心,補給面向世界的知識能量,掌握國際發展趨勢。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bringing you the latest political, economy, information technology and breaking news around the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 您對自己的身體瞭解多少?怎麼樣吃才能吃出健康和美麗?網路上的健康秘方到底是真是假?主持人鄭凱雲、江坤俊醫師與韋汝將為您的健康把關!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: How well do you know your body? What should you eat to be healthy and energetic? Are health tips available online reliable? Tune in to this programme as the hosts give you all the answers!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 節目內容包含時事評論與當天的突發新聞議題,以趙少康為主持的政論節目。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shao Kangs War Room is a Talkshow hosted by Zhao Shao Kang. This programme combines TVBS News source and Mr. Zhaos rich political and media background, to analyse important news deeply.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 性感又時髦的藍心湄, 將節目中化身性感女神, 舉凡女性的私密情慾到美容, 瘦身等話題, 專家為姐姐妹妹分憂解勞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From makeup, skincare, hairstyle, clothing, horoscopes, parenting, to travel, all kinds of fashion-related topics are presented in the program. Pauline Lan leads dozens of professionals and experts across categories to offer the best fashion insights and tips.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《11點熱吵店》透過年輕世代的角度,無論是兩性、職場、人際、時事娛樂等,大談他們最關心、最想發洩、最有意見的熱門話題!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The show invites younger generations to talk about relationship, career, entertainment, current affairs, and all the other popular topics that they care and complain about.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 極具未來感場景的全新益智綜藝節目《拜託ATM》,結合電玩遊戲概念,挑戰者將透過益智競爭,開啟ATM進行終極解碼遊戲。一場科技與智慧的益智競賽《拜託ATM》由行長胡瓜、襄理Sandra與精英挑戰者攜手打..
epg.episode_synopsis_en:
Creating a brand-new interactive ATM that combined with puzzle solving and daily life! Guests can win money by taking three rounds of intellectual challenges from the ATM, turn wisdom into money!
Futuristic program scenes with video game clearing concept, where challengers engage in the intellectual competition to switch on the ATM. Those who won goes to the ultimate challenge. Host Hu Gua, co-host Sandra and the elite challengers will stay together, built up a whole new competition between technology and wisdom!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 實境綜藝節目《演員們的旅行》,在主持人林予晞和範少勳的引領下,將邀請一位演員同行旅遊,透過他人的旅遊清單,深度探討與感受旅遊的多元魅力,從中挑戰自己習以為常的觀點,並享受全新旅遊經驗的樂趣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The reality variety show Actors On The Tour, guided by hosts Allison Lin and Fandy Fan , will invite an actor to travel alongside them. Through the guests travel itinerary, the program aims to delve into the diverse charm of travel, challenging familiar perspectives and relishing the joy of entirely new travel experiences.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Spain is Europes greenhouse. Vast, plastic-covered fields dominate its southern coast to produce up to 25 percent of Europes fruit and veg. But this has a price.
